conclusion: V8 provides the strongest component-isolation design: a sealed n=1,000 gene-component-disjoint retrospective test. V7 retains the stronger archive-time boundary. V8's small paired balanced-accuracy difference from V7 is inconclusive because the component-bootstrap interval crosses zero. Neither is clinical validation.

evidence_summary.own_test_score_context: Own-test balanced accuracies are not ranked because the cohorts and evaluation boundaries differ.

warning: V4-V6 used different internal group-isolated tests. V7 used a later record-level temporal test with same-gene overlap. V8 used a sealed gene-component-disjoint test and includes a paired same-record V7 baseline; its paired confidence interval crosses zero. Other cross-version point estimates are descriptive, not paired head-to-head effects.
